articleTitle: System Architecture Directions for Tangible Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The field of wireless sensor networks has produced a range of supporting hardware and software technologies that facilitate the creation of sensor network applications. Despite these advances, the implementation of wireless sensor network applications remains a complex task that requires domain experts and a significant investment of time and money. This level of investment is often infeasible for single applications, especially for those applications with a short life-cycle. This paper suggests a new direction in wireless sensor network research. We argue that next generation sensor network platforms should strive towards a shared infrastructure, multi-application paradigm, with a clean separation of concerns between infrastructure providers and application developers. These are principles that are well established in the field of Cloud Computing. This paper introduces our vision for future sensor networks, which we refer to as the 'Tangible Cloud'. To support this vision, we introduce a reference architecture and pricing model for sensor network resources.

articleTitle: The Designing of Serial Communication Based on RS232
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This Paper discussed the principle of serial communication mainly, proposed the design method based on RS232, designed the hard circuit of serial communication, and realized the programming to PC Microcomputer and single chip microcomputer by using assembly language and C++ Builder separately.

articleTitle: Applying a Multi-paradigm Approach to Implementing Wireless Sensor Network Based River Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper describes the application of the DisSeNT middleware to implement Wireless Sensor Network based river monitoring. DisSeNT provides LooCI, an efficient run-time reconfigurable component model, PMA, a lightweight policy-based management framework and QARI, a declarative quality-aware deployment framework. Using a river monitoring case-study, this paper analyses how these distinct software development paradigms can be used in a complimentary fashion to develop efficient wireless sensor network applications. The resulting system has been deployed and evaluated in a real-world river monitoring scenario in the city of São Carlos, Brazil.

articleTitle: Towards a Unified Framework for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS)
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) integrate computation with physical processes. By merging computing and communication with physical processes CPS allows computer systems to monitor and interact with the physical world. However, today's computing and networking abstractions do not adequately reflect the properties of the physical world. This shortcoming necessitates the development of effective methods and tools for analyzing and designing CPS. This paper analyzes the limitation of the current tools and method and proposes a unified framework for designing, simulating, and verifying CPS.

articleTitle: Technique and Application of End-Hopping in Network Defense
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: End-hopping is a technique proposed in the study of active defense in network security. In this paper, some supplements and modifications are made to the conception of "End-hopping" based on the previous research of our group. And the formal description is put forward. Methods are discussed to implement End-hopping for active defense. After analyzing the shortcomings of service migration, a new technique is designed which called "Middle Agent", with better performance. And this technique is applied to the End-hopping prototype system. By attacking to the prototype system, the feasibility and anti-attack capability of End-hopping technique are proven.

articleTitle: A New Coding Algorithm for Information Security Based on Strong Calculation and Uniform Scattering
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper introduces a new coding algorithm to strengthen information security. Using the strong calculation and uniform scattering technologies etc, messages can be added into much redundancy to shield original intention. And a demonstrative example is present at last to illustrate the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: MIDI-Based Software for Real-Time Network Performances
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Realizing the software based on MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface), with which MIDI instruments geographically distributed over Internet could be real-time played or synthetic performed. By access local MIDI input instruments to obtain signals, the software can help access local MIDI input instruments to implement local play. At the same time it can also obtain MIDI message in real-time and send signals through the Internet, synthesizing at a remote terminal to implement remote interactive performance. We use input buffer on a remote synthetic server to resolve the issue of network transmission delay.

articleTitle: Mixed Experimental Methodologies to Optimize Biosurfactant Production Conditions of Pseudomonas Aeruginosa
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In order to reduce production cost of Pseudomonas aeruginosa T1, which has the ability of producing the biosurfactant when using crude oil as the sole carbon source, Three experimental methodologies (Plackett-Burman design (PBD), steepest ascent design (SAD), Central composite rotatable design (CCRD)) were applied to optimize the medium ingredients of the strain. In the verification experiment, the surface tension (ST) of strain T1 fermentation decreased from 29.93mN/m to 27.08mN/m after medium optimization.

articleTitle: Density-Based Data Streams Subspace Clustering over Weighted Sliding Windows
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Most real-world data sets are characterized by a high dimensinal, inherely sparse data space. In this paper, we present a novel density-based approach to the subspace clustering problem. A new framework for data stream mining is introduced, called the weighted sliding window. In the online component, the structure of Exponential Histogram of Cluster Feature(EHCF) is improved to maintain the micro-clusters. The concepts of potential core-micro-cluster and outlier micro-cluster are applied to distinguish the potential clusters and outliers. A novel pruning strategy is proposed to decrease the number of micro-clusters. In the offline component, the final clusters are generated by SUBCLU algorithm. Our performance study demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: A Method of Security Gradation against RSA IEA
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A key security level gradation method is proposed which is helpful to counter IEA (Iterative Encryption Attack) and provides RSA with favorable immunity against it. Firstly, we analyze the course of IEA in detail, and then present the concept of security grade of key-pair and the hierarchy of grades, and propose an algorithm that grades security grade of key-pairs. Secondly, we define the concept of attack cost, and then launch a series of experiments for the purpose of exploring the relationship between attack cost and key security grade. At last, it is demonstrated that if to choose keys properly by this method RSA is improved to be effective to counter IEA in aspect of computation power.

articleTitle: The Standard S Control Chart with Run Rules
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The application of standard |s| control chart with two run rules in control of process variability is discussed in this paper. The control limits and average run length(ARL) are computed by the method of Markov chain. The results show that the standard |s| control chart with run rules has smaller ARL than the standard |s| control chart for all kinds of magnitudes of shifts. In the end, an example accompanied by simulation is used to illustrate that the chart with run rules is more sensitive to shifts in the process variability.

articleTitle: Constructing Copulas on the Parabolic Boundary of Kendall's Tau-Spearman's Rho Region
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Copula is an effective method that describes the joint distribution of dependent random variables. Meanwhile, Kendall's tau and Spearman's rho are two common and important measures measuring the dependence for random variables. The expression form of Kendall's tau - Spearman's rho region has been given and every point on the linear portion of the boundary is attainable. However, it is not determined that other points could be attainable on the parabolic boundary, although countable points could be attainable because of a known family of Copulas at present. Based on constructing a family of Copulas for which Kendall's tau and Spearman's rho lie on the countable points of parabolic boundary by convex combination, and this paper obtains another new family of Copulas for which Kendall's tau and Spearman's rho lie on points of parabolic boundary by ordinal sum.

articleTitle: Spline Estimate of Nonlinear Trend for Time Series
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A nonparametric regression model with fixed design and linear process errors is considered in this paper. Based on polynomial spline estimation, optimal global rate of convergence of the estimator of nonlinear trend for time series is obtained. The fitted trend for the CNY/EUR foreign exchange rate series is given.

articleTitle: The Study of Island Remote Sensing Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Because of the effects of various factors in remote sensing image acquisition process, the remote sensing image has a low quality. This paper uses histogram equalization, histogram specification and wavelet transformation respectively to realize image enhancement. The image is satellite remote sensing image of pingtan island of Fujian province. The histogram equalization can adjust the whole image contrast automatically. While histogram specification enhances the contrast of a grayscale range selectively. Wavelet transform is an analysis method of time-frequency localization.

articleTitle: ARMA Model Parameter Optimized Estimate Method
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The ARMA model is the most basic sequential method and the practical application of the most comprehensive time series model. It expands and develops in the linear regression model foundation. The ARMA model not only may promulgate dynamic data's structure and the rule, will forecast its future value, moreover may also from the various research system's related characteristic, the ARMA model's parameter estimation will be studied in this model process, it is an important link, it will be a nonlinear optimization process. This article presents an ARMA model parameter estimation method, this approach uses the nonlinear least squares method which is a combination of Gauss-Newton method, and using a genetic algorithm with BFGS symmetric positive definite matrix to approximate Hesse matrix inverse, to accelerate the convergence of computing and to improve the accuracy of the estimated model parameters. Has carried on the parameter estimation and the forecast using this algorithm to GDP index series, obtained the satisfactory result. The experiment's result had indicated that this method had the good accuracy in the parameter estimation aspect and the forecast performance.

articleTitle: Improving VQ Index Compression with Modified Relative Index Table
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Image Vector Quantization (VQ) has many current applications, like speech and image compression, and envisioned applications, such as digital watermarking, data hiding and speaker identification. Given an image, VQ produce an index map by quantizing the image block by block. Recently, a loss less VQ index compression scheme, called Index Searching Algorithm with index Associated List (ISAIAL), was proposed to improve the VQ performance by using relative index table. The basic idea behind ISAIAL is to utilize the effect of correlation between adjacent indices in the index map. In this paper, two modified relative index tables are proposed to improve the performance of ISAIAL further. The computation of optimal size for modified relative index tables is also addressed. The proposed methods were evaluated via extensive experiments. The results show that the ISAIAL is improved by the proposed methods. Moreover, our approaches apparently reduce the bit rate as compared to the conventional VQ and some commercial loss less compressors, such as rar, zip and arj.

articleTitle: The Decision Model Research Based on Cooperative Game with Interest Subject of Venture Capital Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The venture success is determined by how the interest subject of venture capital investment measures the feasibility of cooperation and the consequential decision about cooperation. This study analyses the relationship between venture entrepreneur and venture companies, venture capitalist in order to study the basis on which the interest subject makes decision to cooperate in the venture capital investment. Then the cooperative game model of venture investment capital decision was built with the investment quotas and the level of management as decision variables, and venture entrepreneur and venture capitalist as players. Finally, the example calculation verifies the feasibility and accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Comparison between Nonnormal Process Capability Study Based on Two Kinds of Transformations
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Standard process capability index is based on the assumption that process output obeys normal distribution. There exist a lot of process outputs which don't obey normal distribution, such as F distribution, Γ distribution, χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> distribution, and β distribution. There are many ways to transform non-normal data to normal data, two of which are using the Box-Cox transformation and Johnson transformation. In this paper, some nonnormal distributions are studied by using these two transformations respectively, their process capability indexes are calculated, and the applicability and effectiveness of the two methods in process capability analysis are studied through a large number of repeated simulations. It is shown that Johnson transformation is more effective than Box-Cox transformation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Divisibility in Thenar Palmprint with Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Proposed a texture analysis method that based on the combination of the Gabor filters and 2DPCA. Through Gabor filter obtained the multi-direction and multi-resolution Gabor sub-image in the time and frequency domains. The Gabor sub-images were processed by 2DPCA, and extracted the multi-scale and multi-orientation feature vector. Finally using Euclidean distance measure the similarity of different classes. The experiment proved the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Three-Motor Synchronous Speed-Regulation System Based on RBF Neural Network Control
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Three-motor synchronous speed-regulation system is a multi-input multi-output (MIMO), nonlinear, and coupling complex control system. This paper focuses on the system of induction motors powered by current-track type SPWM transducers, establishes the mathematical model of the system in the way of analytical expression. Self-tuning PID controllers based on RBF neural network and neuron decoupling compensator are adopted to realize the adaptive decoupling control of speed and tension. Simulation and experiment results show that compared with traditional PED constant parameters control, the control system can obtain optimal parameters of the PID controller according to online identification of the RBF network, realize the better decoupling control of speed and tension, and possess better dynamic and static performance and good robustness. Thus, the method presented in the paper meets the requirements of many industrial control environments, with good application prospects. And it can be extended to the usual multimotor (n≥3) system.

articleTitle: Unified Approach to Construct 8X8 Binary Matrices with Branch Number 5
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: We focus on {0, 1}-matrices of size 8×8 and provide a unified method to construct all {0, 1}-matrices of size 8×8 whose branch numbers are 5. And using the constructed results, we can find that the total Hamming weight of them varies from 33 to 44. While the type of total Hamming weight 44 has been used in cipher E2 and Camellia, we can use the other types in designing linear transformation of an SPN cipher.

articleTitle: The Processing Method of Chinese Characters in TCL Scripting Language
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: For solving the difficult problem of testing Chinese characters in TCL scripting language (ActiveTcl 8.5.7.0), deeping analysis of the TCL language processing mechanism about the Chinese characters, prposing one processing method of Chinese characters based on GBK encoding. Solving the generation of Chinese characters, excluding idle codes and the displaying problem on TCL testing platform. Extending a TCL command, the realization of judge the length of Chinese characters correctly. So the processing about Chinese characters on the TCL platform becomes simple.

articleTitle: Line-Skeleton Extraction of 3D Meshes Based on Geometry Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Skeleton is a fundamental shape feature of 3D mesh, and it can be used in many areas, such as model search, shape analysis, and mesh deformation. This paper presents a novel skeleton extraction method based on mesh segmentation. Firstly, the mesh is cut off by Dijkstras Algorithm and the number of segments N, then the relevant sub-meshes centers are connected to constitute the skeleton. At last, the noise of the skeleton is removed to get the final result. The algorithm is proved robust and fast through the many model demonstrations.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Diagnosis Instrument for Speed Control System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The operating status of the Electronic Speed Controller and the engine of the cannon needed to be evaluated and checked in ordinary maintenance, examination and repair. A useful fault diagnosis system for Electronic Speed Controller was designed by LabVIEW. The system was composed by magneto electric spin speed sensor, junction box, PWM driven module, PCI1802 multi-function card and Apolo530 industry control portable computer. It could be used to measure and simulate the signal of the magneto electric spin speed sensor or the executor and also could be used to diagnose the faults of the sensor, adjust board and executor of the Electronic Speed Controller. Reliability and convenience of the system was showed in the simulation running experiment.

articleTitle: Completeness of Random Exponential Systems in the Weighted Banach Space
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, the authors investigate the completeness of random exponential systems {t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λn(ω)t</sup>} in C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub>, where C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub> is the weighted Banach space of complex continuous functions of f on R with f(t)exp(-α(t)) vanishing at infinity.

articleTitle: Some Limit Properties for Nonhomogeneous Tree Indexed Markov Chains
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The paper defined a nonhomogeneous tree T with the methods of the modulus of congruence of and obtained the strong law of large numbers on frequency occurrence of the r-dimensional state sequences for tree T indexed Markov chains.

articleTitle: Ohba's Conjecture is True for Graphs K_6,3*t,2*(k-2t-4),1*(t+3)
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A graph G is called chromatic-choosable if ch(G)=χ(G). Ohba's conjecture states that every graph G with 2χ(G)+1 or fewer vertices is chromatic-choosable. In this paper we show that Ohba's conjecture is true for complete multipartite graphs K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6,3*t,2*(k-2t-4),1*(t+3)</sub> and its all k-chromatic sub graphs for all integers t≥0 and k≥2t+4, that is, ch(K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6,3*t,2*(k-2t-4),1*(t+3)</sub>)=k, which extends the result ch(K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6,3*t,2*(k-6),1*4</sub>)=k given by Shen et al. [J. of Mathematical Research and Exposition, 27(2)(2007) 264-272].

articleTitle: The Security Research of Network Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, Network access control system structure and network security technologies are commonly used research. On this basis, a random number generator, packet key encryption algorithms DES, RSA public key system and the message authentication code MAC as the main security policy, design and implement network access control system network security solutions, is safe, simple, high reliability, making network access control systems greatly improve network security.

articleTitle: T-Chord: A Two-Layer Routing Model for Chord
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Routing is essential in P2P applications. Chord is a kind of structured P2P network, but its routing table can only cover half of the Chord ring. As long as target node is in the half ring which is not covered by the routing table, the target node must be found via not less than one medium node, namely, two hops. So, Chord is not very efficient. Therefore, a two-layer routing model for Chord(T-Chord) is proposed. By logically constructing inter-domain transmitting network on the Chord, the target node which is not in the same half ring with the originating lookup node can possibly be found in only one hop. Thus, the covering problem of Chord routing table can be solved well. Simulation experiments show that T-Chord reduces the average lookup path length and gets higher efficiency.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm Based on Prefix Tree for Sequence Pattern Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Algorithm PTPSPM (a parallel algorithm based on prefix tree for sequence pattern mining) is proposed in order to deal with the speed limited and effectiveness problem of the sequence pattern mining in massive data. In this paper, a new prefix-tree structure and an improved prefix-span algorithm are introduced to mine the local sequence, the global sequence are obtained by merging all the local sequences. A new prefix tree pruning technique is presented to delete the global k-sequence which can not be attended. PTPSPM algorithm applies project database identifier index table of dynamic scheduling to avoid the processor idle waiting. Additionally, it cites selective sampling techniques to balance the loads between processors. The experiment results demonstrate that PTPSPM algorithm has better execution performance and speedup.

articleTitle: Study of the Thinning Algorithm for Thenar Palmprint
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The disadvantages of the Fast Thinning Algorithm and Improved OPTA Thinning Algorithm, i.e. incomplete thinning, not smooth and burr were analyzed and studied. The serial algorithm based on 4-connectivity parallel thinning was presented which had the advantage of quick speed and complete thinning. The lookup tables method was introduced in order to improve the operation speed. The thinned thenar palm print skeleton is smooth, no burr and located in the center of the ridge. The result of experiment is perfect.

articleTitle: TR-BFGS Algorithm for Multi-layer Feed-Forward Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The most popular algorithm training feed-forward neural networks is the back-propagation algorithm which minimizes the error function using the steepest descent direction. In practice, although, even with a small learning rate which slows down the training process, the BP algorithm can exhibit oscillatory behavior when it encounters steep valleys. Trust region method has advantages of global convergence and quick convergence rate and so on. Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfard-Shano (BFGS) has advantages of computing only an approximation to the inverse of Hessian matrix, that is no second derivatives calculated. Also, the BFGS Hessian matrix update is symmetric and positive definite, making the algorithm numerically stable. This article presents an efficient training algorithm, namely TR-BFGS algorithm, combining with both of their advantages. We evaluate the convergence speed of proposed algorithm by using an example of approximation of function. The experimental results show that the new TR-BFGS algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Transductive Support Vector Machine and Its Application to the Environmental Monitoring of Greenhouse Plant Growth
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The study on Transductive Support Vector Machine (TSVM) has made little progress since Vapnik has put forth the concept in the late 1990s, as the algorithm for TSVM optimization model cannot be easily found. Here we try to transform the problem of TSVM optimization into an unconstrained one and then to construct the smooth unconstrained optimization with a kernel. Based on this optimization, a TSVM of which optimization problem is easier to solve is devised to break through the bottleneck of deepening the research on TSVM. Furthermore, this TSVM is applied to the environmental monitoring of greenhouse plant growth as a new method.

articleTitle: The Complete Asymptotic Expansion for the Operators of Bleinmann-Butzer and Hahn-Durrmeyer with Double Parameters a, ß
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Based on the relationship of the weighted BBH-D operator and the Bernstein-Durrmeyer operator with the Jacobi's right, we obtain the complete asymptotic expansion for the operators of Bleinmann-Butzer and Hahn-Durrmeyer with Double Parameters α, β.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Application Communication Based on Embedded Network Terminal
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Lots of chat software and e-mail client software can run in the personal computer, but for some specific embedded network terminal, which leads to some problems like big size and so on. Aiming at the hardware systems and operating systems of embedded network terminal, solutions for chat software and e-mail client software based on embedded network terminal were proposed. In this paper, the design of chat software and e-mail client software were described in detail, after analyzing the network socket programming, the e-mail system theory and related protocols. The chat software successfully achieves the communications of embedded network terminals and embedded network terminals, the communication of embedded network terminals and personal computers. The e-mail client software is provided with Greater flexibility and scalability. It not only can send and receive messages in both English and Chinese, but also possess of other functions, for example, displaying the mail attachment content without downloading or downloading attachment.

articleTitle: Block Diagonalization and a Numerical Method of the Eigenproblem for an n×n Normal Matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: It is important that the eigenproblem of a matrix is solved in the matrix analysis and its engineering application. For a normal matrix with multiplex eigenvalues, a method of block diagonalization is given by using Householder transformation and finding eigenvectors of the tridiagonal Hermitian matrix. On the basis of this, a numerical method of finding its eigenvalues and eigenvectors is obtained.

articleTitle: Shrinking Projection Methods for a Sequence of Hemi-Reltively Nonexpansive Mappings in Banach Spaces
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, we prove a strong convergence theorem by the shrinking projection method for a sequence of hemi-relatively nonexpansive mappings in Banach space.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Data Analysis Method Based on Intelligence Computation
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper mainly studies on the problem of the intelligence evolution technology. It combines the automation of program design and discrete data, applies the overall structure and the superiority of the GEP algorithm. It takes sunspots for test example and analysis data, designs corresponding and reasonable GEP algorithm, depicts the regulation of data and forecasts the development trend of data in order to achieve accurate fitting of data.

articleTitle: Note on Two-f-Tolerance Competition Graphs
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Let φ be a symmetric function defined from N×N into N, where N denotes the nonnegative integers. A graph G=(V,E) is a φ-tolerance competition graph if there is a digraph D=(V,A) such that each vertex v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>∈V can be assigned a nonnegative integer t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> such that, for i≠j, v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>∈E if and only if |O(v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>)∩O(v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>)|≥φ(t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>,t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>). Brigham et al. defined the two-φ-tolerance competition graph as a tolerance competition graph in which all the t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> are selected from a 2-set. They characterized such graphs and discussed the relationships between them for φ equal to the minimum, maximum, and sum functions, with emphasis on the situation in which the 2-set is {0,q}. In this paper, we continue to study two-φ-tolerance competition graphs. Characterizations of such graphs, and the lower bounds of θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">φ</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">{p,q}</sup>(G), are presented for φ=min, max and sum, respectively, with emphasis on the situation in which the 2-set is {p,q}.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Parallel Machine Scheduling on Any Number of Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, we present algorithms for the problem of scheduling n independent jobs on m identical machines. As a generalization of the classical parallel machine scheduling problem each machine is available only at a machine dependent release time. For the problem of minimizing the make span, we develop a kind of linear time algorithm with a tight bound of 1+(m-1)/m. For the problem Pm|non-increasing job, known optimum|C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>, we develop a kind of algorithm with a tight bound of 5/4, when m=4, the algorithm has a tight bound of 6/5.

articleTitle: On the Ruin Probability for a Dependent Risk Model under the Heavy-Tailed
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper introduced the insurance company light and heavy tail of debt risk model, with assumption is negatively associated relationship. Basing on the nature of and negatively associated sequences, this paper transform different types of dependency risk models to only one type, and derived the ruin probability of the model.

articleTitle: Study of Noise Reduction about Economic Time Series Data Based on ICA
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper raised a new method about noise-reduction for 1D economic time series data based on ICA, making use of high rank statistical peculiarity of ICA, because of a large number of noises contained in economic series data. We expand 1D signal to many dims, drawing into invented noise components, and separate blind source. Compared to adapt-self filter, this method is excel enter. Authentic proof making effect clearly.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Bionic and ERP Application
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Bionic study is a new hot research of the management and emerges recently. It builds a connection between the phenomenon of biological life and the problem of economy management, attempt to utilize the features and evolution principles of organic world to analyze and explain the development and changes in non-living world. Based on the results of bionic study of enterprise lifecycle and evolution, the ERP of application is discussed in this paper. Finally, a model of ERP management information systems based on bionic is proposed.

Author Keywords: Model of ERP based on Bionic

articleTitle: A Method for Nonlinear Equation's Simple Roots
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, we present the convergence behavior of a modified Newton's method based on Simpson integral rule. The convergence properties of this method for solving equations which have simple roots have been discussed and it has been shown that it converges cubically to simple roots. The values of the corresponding asymptotic error constants of convergence are determined. Theoretical results have been verified on the relevant numerical problems. In addition, we also point out that if combined with other numerical methods such as improved Ostrowski's method, the SN method can be more efficient.

articleTitle: Extrapolation Methods to Compute the Hypersingular Integral on Interval
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The composite trapezoidal rule for the computation of Hadamard finite-part integral on interval with the hyper singular kernel 1/(t-s)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is discussed and the case of the mesh point coinciding with the singular point by generalized finite-part definition is considered. The asymptotic expansion is obtained and an extrapolation algorithm is presented to accelerate the convergence rate. Based on the Toeplitz matrix discrete, we prove of convergence rate the singular integral equation is O(h). At last, some numerical results are also presented to confirm the theoretical results and the efficiency of the algorithms is shown.

articleTitle: Security Design on Construction Machinery Running Attention System
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Through the analysis of CMRAS security design and security system security threats at all levels, including application layer, data access and processing layer, data layer, based on network layer, so as to formulate the corresponding security policies and response measures to ensure security of confidential data transfer and storage in CMRAS, including the technical parameters for construction machinery, operating data, remote operation command, location and other information. The measures also increase the stability of the system's operation, reduce the system failure rate to ensure the safe operation of machinery and the failure of timely diagnosis and maintenance, in the practical application of the good effect. In practical applications it has made the best results.

articleTitle: Legendre Wavelets Method for Nonlinear Fractional Differences Equation
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper we consider a kind of polynomials-Legendre polynomials then we get Legendre wavelet. Legendre wavelet operational matrix of the fractional integration is derived and combined the property of operational matrix to solve nonlinear fractional differential equations, we give some example and the numerical example shows that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Discussion of Complex integration on Complex Contours
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper elaborated on the complex integration on the complex contour, and gave the calculation formula of complex integrals according to different cases with different number of singular points, namely, one singular point, n singular points, infinite singular points (countable). Therefore, it is easy to analysis and understand the development and establishment of complex integration on complex contour. Besides, this paper introduced and proved an "improved residue theorem" base on the famous residue theorem, which make it possible to calculate complex integral with countable singular point in an unbounded region.

articleTitle: Resistance Capability of Irradiation Room by Explosive Load
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Like nuclear power station, once the irradiation room was damaged, nuclear radiation accident will occur, causing the serious nuclear panic. Therefore, a typical structure of irradiation room was presented for an example in this paper to establish a method on evaluating the resistance capability of irradiation room by explosive load. Worrying about explosives under the radical source, the greatest explosives weight was determined at the different explosion location by tensile strength of concrete, and the resistant explosive capacity of the reinforced concrete beam was accounted.

articleTitle: Base on the BP Network of Chinese Studies Recognitions System
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The paper introduces current character recognition and using artificial neural network for pattern recognition theory, studies the BP neural network technique in character recognition system, expounds the application of the recognition system of basic principle, model and analysis results of recognition, and some Suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Precision Virtual Spectrum Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A spectrum analyzer based on the virtual instrument is introduced in this thesis. This spectrum analyzer is able to analyze the auto-power spectrum, amplitude spectrum and phase spectrum, which can recognize 0.01 Hz. The author aims to analyze the detailed operating results of virtual spectrum analyzer by discussing the design and realization of this kind of analyzer, which proves the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model in Work of Teacher Recruitment
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In the interviewing of teacher recruitment, each member of the expert group need to evaluate the comprehensive quality of the candidates. This evaluation always involved several elements and indexes. Composite fuzzy judge decision-making was used to analyze the evaluation of the expert group, and line up the comprehensive quality of the candidates quantitatively.

articleTitle: A MAS Application Research in City Traffic System
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, we first analyze the problems regarding some of the current traffic control systems. Based on MAS and ITS system, we present an intelligent traffic system control approach which can be efficient to tackle the traffic congestion problems.

articleTitle: A Comparable Study on PNCC in Speaker Diarization for Meetings
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In speaker diarization, the most commonly used speaker feature is MFCC, which is also most commonly used speech feature in speech recognition. The newly proposed Power Normalized Cepstrum Coefficients (PNCC) achieves impressive improvement in noisy speech recognition compare to MFCC. It consequently expects a proof for speaker diarization use. In this paper, PNCC is evaluated against MFCC in a meeting domain speaker diarization system. The Diarization Error Rate (DER) shows no positive results with PNCC. This is possibly because of their inhibition in high frequency spectrum which is believed to represents the characteristics of human's voice.

articleTitle: The Generalization of Trichotomy and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Determination of the membership functions is vital in practical applications of the fuzzy sets theory. In this paper we generate the trichotomy, or in other words, we present and proof the quartering and multi-faceted. This paper is organized in the following way: in Section 2 we describe the basic theorem. Section 3 is devoted to the new theorem that we proposed. In section 4 an illustrative example is presented.

articleTitle: The Exploitation of Electronic Government Administration System Applied to Submission
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: to construct the frame of the Electronic Government administration system according to submitting and demanding. The main security demanding of the system is analyzed, and digital signature and encryption tachniques are used to construct a model to solve these security problems.

articleTitle: Construction of Combination Forecasting Model and Related Validation -- Based on Combined Forecast of Sales Tax and Enterprise Income Tax in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The value of forecast lies in the prophet of future, and having an important impact on decision-making, Therefore, from the relevant of taxation and economic angle, using analytical methods integrating qualitative and quantitative analysis, based on macroeconomic indicators data of Heilongjiang Province since 1999, through the building of combined forecast model, It is going to forecast revenue organized by the local tax departments in the future 3 years, and provide intellectual support for decision-making of the local government. Studies have shown that predicted results through the authentication, are in line with the actual.

articleTitle: Universal Adjoint Action for Quantum Algebra wsl_q (2)
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The present paper give the necessary and sufficient condition that wsl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(2) is a quasi-module algebra over itself, then prove that the two locally finite submodule F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>(wsl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(2)) and F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>(W) are equal. At last, we investigate the structure of the submodule F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>(wsl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(2)) and give the decomposition of simple module of F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>(wsl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(2)).

articleTitle: The Dual of a Special Martingale Hardy Space
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, the dual of a novel martingale Hardy space generated by α-mean-square operator is addressed. Fefferman's inequality is proved to hold for 1 ≤ α ≤ 2 and 1 ≤ p ≤ α. Meanwhile, the dual space of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Sα</sup> is characterized and proved in the case. The result shows that for 1 ≤ α ≤ 2 and 1 ≤ p ≤ a , the dual space of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Sα</sup> can be characterized by Garsia space <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub>K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>.

articleTitle: Clear-Level Robot Based on Laser Control and Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Control and measurement system adopts laser emitter as signal source of height control and inclination angle sensor as detecting unit of horizontal control of clear-level robot. After the laser signal is carried through the light filter, and then amplified and modulated, last transmitted to controller. The inclination sensor measures the slope angle of the x and y verticality direction. The two-way signal is processed at intervals, and then transmitted to controller. Laser and inclination angle signal is separately treated. Controller controls the executive part to make clear-level robot work on a leveling plane. The test result shows that the leveling precision of robot reaches ±2.5mm/100 and based on on-line control and measurement system the working parts can always work on the parallel plane to datum plane that is scanned and confirmed by laser emitter and retain ±0.05°with the leveling datum plane.

articleTitle: A New Kind of Indirect Adaptive Fuzzy Control Which Based on Type-2 Fuzzy Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A new Type-2 fuzzy control is based on Type-1 indirect adaptive fuzzy control, the antecedents and consequents of rules are changed into Type-2 fuzzy sets. In this paper, Type-2 fuzzy sets are used to establish indirect adaptive fuzzy controller and the stability of the controller is discussed, and the convergence of the controller is researched, and plausibility is presented.

articleTitle: The Reliability Analysis of the Repairable System
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper we consider the system of M/M/N queue with service interruptions, the rates of server breakdown are different between busy time and idle time, and there is one repairman in its system. We give out the group of equations for the steady state distribution of the number of effective servers. We obtain the steady-state probabilities of the states and the steady-state availability of the system.

articleTitle: Keynotes
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Factors Affecting the Income of the Farmers in Rural Tourism of Dujiangyan City on the Base of Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: A large amount of data is obtained through questionares, on the basis of which, a multiple linear regression model have been established. With the application of MATLAB software, we have learned though the correlation analysis, of which the prediction accuracy is calculated to be "r = 54.25", that the three main factors affecting the income of peasants are : educational background, the distance between the housing site and the scenic spot and professional types. Furthermore, these three factors have a linear correlations to the farmers' income.

articleTitle: Studying About Mechanism of Pronunciation "mum" Based on Method of Functional Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, we focus on word "mum" which is a popular word all over the wold, and study its EMG curves using Method of Functional Data Analysis. We show that linear model for the data and the estimated regression function can be extended to area of neural activation. If we research the acceleration of some body part, we are getting close to seeing how this remarkable control mechanism produces the movement that we see and feel. The goal of this paper is giving some help for computational simulation of human's pronunciation by studying about mechanism of pronunciation "mum".

articleTitle: The High Order Zero-Difference Representation of the Solutions to a System of Vandermonde Linear Equations
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: By using the theory of linear algebra and the calculus of differences, a typical representation of the solution to a system of linear equations is presented. The representation makes the solution to linear equations more concise and succinct.

articleTitle: The Calculation of the Customer Potential Value Using Association Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The calculation of the Customer Potential Value has enormous impact to the enterprise efficiency. In this paper, based on the analysis of purchased products or services, we use Association Algorithm to predict the purchasing products or services that customer will buy in future and purchasing probability, then calculate the potential value of customer. Finally we accomplish the data mining process.

articleTitle: Atuomorphism Group of Simple Lie Algebra C_q[x^±1, y^±1, z^±1]/C
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, the automorphisms and anti-automorphisms of a class of simple associative algebra C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>:=C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>[x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±1</sup>, y<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±1</sup>, z<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±1</sup>] are studied, then the automorphisms of a class of simple Lie algebra C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>/C are determined.

articleTitle: S*-pairwise Compactness in L-bitopological Space
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In this paper, a notion of S*-pair wise compactness in L-bitopological space is introduced and its basical properties are studied. It is proved that the intersection of an S*-pair wise compactness L-set with a biclosed L-set ( resp., the finite sum of some S*-pair wise compactness L-sets, the continuous image of an S*-pair wise compactness L-set and the product of some S*-pair wise compactness L-sets) is S*-pair wise compactness. And for a weakly induced L-bitopological space, it is S*-pair wise compact if and only if its background space is B-pair wise compact.

articleTitle: An Optimization Model of Elevators Group Zoning Dispatching and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Considering the difficultly of passengers taking elevators in up-peak traffic mode, this paper studies and gives an optimal strategy of elevator group dynamic zoning dispatching. Firstly, this paper explains the basis and algorithm about this elevator group dynamic zoning dispatching model. Then it establishes one elevator service quality model and one elevator energy loss model separately. Based on those and the multi-objective optimization method, ultimately it establishes an optimization model of elevator group zoning dispatching. Finally, the superiority of the model is verified by one example.

articleTitle: Random Approximation with Weak Contraction Random Operator and Random Fixed Point Theorem for Nonexpansive Random Mapping
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In real reflexive separable Banach space which admits a weakly sequentially continuous duality mapping, the sufficient and necessary condition that nonexpansive random mapping has a random fixed point is obtained. By introducing a random iteration process with weak contraction random operator, we obtain the convergence theorem of the random iteration process to a random fixed point for nonexpansive random mapping.

articleTitle: Study on the Self-Organization Evolutionary Process of Cluster Innovation Based on the Theory of Knowledge Flow
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In the study of innovation theory, some scholars believe that innovation process is the process of knowledge evolution. Cluster innovation is a complex economic activity based on knowledge resource, It is systematic, procedure, and with the evolutionary process of innovation self-organized. In this process, the knowledge structures of cluster innovation alternate by the path of "stability-bifurcation-stability", and it also contains the gradual improvement of the structure of innovation knowledge linked to learning and the breakthrough innovation of such structure associated with variation. Industrial cluster innovation is the combination, equivalence and integration of the two above models.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Set Model of Locality Problem in Ubiquitous Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In ubiquitous computing environment, user application requires close interaction with the network nodes in its proximity, the interactions are opportunistic and unpredictable with the user's movement. This paper names this phenomenon as a locality problem and provides a model of this problem based on fuzzy set theory. Fuzzy synthetic evaluation method is used to evaluate the local scene members. An architecture containing this mechanism is given. Experiment results verify correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Campus Data Sharing Based on the Web Services Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper describes the technical background of web services. Then use web services technology to achieve the design of the campus data sharing, include the entire system analysis, design process, which introduces a data maintenance, data sharing, data access realization of three modules.

articleTitle: Study of Members Damage Early-Warning System for Frame Structures Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Two damage anomalous filters which were set up by BP neural network have been used to alarm the damage in structural members. After dealing with eigenparameter extracted from damaged and intact structure, different input data is considered for setting up different damage warning anomalous filters. Filter □: the first eight natural frequencies are chosen as input data of network. Filter □: one mode damage index DSI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> is chosen as input data of network. Six damaged work conditions have been discussed in the paper, and the result of analysis shows that using the composite indicator for structural damage detection is accurate, efficient and convenient in engineering.

articleTitle: Mathematical Method of a New Fast BEM for 2D Potential Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The boundary element method (BEM) has been successfully applied to 2D and 3D large scale potential problems and efficiently reduce the computing operations and memory requirements. In this paper, by using Laplace Transformation, a new kind of fast BEM for 2D potential problems is presented. Using this method, the logarithm operation can be converted to product operation, the calculation complexity can be reduced. and the computational speed can be improved.

articleTitle: E-convex Bilevel Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: This paper presents E-convex linear programming problem from the theorems and expands the single E-convex programming into double. And also E-convex programming definition and some theorems are given, which enriched the field of bilevel linear programming.

articleTitle: Research on the Governance Structure of Urban Commerce Zone Based on Life Cycle Evolution
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: The structure of urban commerce zone is usually complicated and hard to be governed. Therefore, this paper analyzes every development process of the commerce zone from the view of life cycle evolution, and then determines the governance structure of urban commerce zone from the view of transaction cost of property. Finally the paper makes some relevant proposals.

articleTitle: T-Colorings of Multigraphs
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: T-colorings of multigraphs are a more practical case of T-colorings of graphs where interference may occur on different level. A multigraph G can be partitioned into K distinct sets, so we represent G as G(V,G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>,G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>,...,G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K-1</sub>). The span of a T-coloring of G equals max |f(x)-f(y)|, where the maximum is taken over all edges {x, y} ϵ E(G). The minimum order, and minimum span, where the minimum is taken over all T-colorings of G, are denoted by X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>(G), and sp<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>(G), respectively. We will show several previous results of multigraphs, and we also will present a new algorithm to compute sp<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>(G) of multigraphs.

articleTitle: Comments on Cache-Timing Attacks on Stream Ciphers
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Cache-timing attacks on the Advanced Encryption Standard block cipher provoked a mass reaction against use of s-boxes in cipher design. This reduced diversity in design strategies. We show that s-boxes can be safely used in stream ciphers, provided that consideration is given to minimizing information leakage.

articleTitle: To Improve the Measurement of the Brewster Angle and the Refractive Index of the Glass by Using CCD and Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: We have improved the method of the measurement for the Brewster angle and the refractive index of the glass by using the detection system of spectrometer and CCD, and as a result, the accuracy of the measurement has been increased greatly.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Factors of the Braked Force Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: As the key of braked friction coefficient automatic testing system between tyre and road, the influence factors of the braked force coefficient are very important. The influence factors of braked force coefficient, including the testing speed, tyre type and model, water film thickness and the temperature of road surface etc. are studied and analysised in this paper. The water film thickness and the road surface temperature are influenced by the enivorment. So the analysis method and impact formulation are put up by lots of research and experiment. Finally, the correlation experiment be completed in the typical road. The results show that the method and formulation is acceptable.

articleTitle: Easily Create Context Help
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Context help can help people to quickly understand and master the software you developed, it is the software window. During the later stages of a project, every application developers have been through help file. You will find yourself spending some time working with an HTML Help author to connect the screens and dialogs of your application to context sensitive help. This article introduces a new way of instrumenting your code that enables help authors associate help topics with the application's visual contexts at any time - even post-compilation - and to do so using the application's user interface without the involvement of the developer.

articleTitle: A Data Hiding System Based on Length of English Text
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Now traditional encryption is becoming more and more unsafe. So many people find information hiding technology is a good solution for security in some special area. In this paper, we design and implement a data hiding system based on the length of English text document and secret message encryption. The method that divide secret message into blocks before embedding can increase capacity. Using DES encrypt secret message greatly improves the security of the system. We implement this system using VBA, and analyses its security, capacity and availability, and then point out the feasibility and the advantages of the system.

articleTitle: Global Robust Stability Analysis Interval Bidirectional Associative Memory Neural Networks with Inverse Lipschitz Neuron Activations
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: In the paper, by using topological degree theory and Lyapunov function method, the issue of global robust stability is investigated for a class of interval bidirectional associative memory neural networks with inverse Lipschitz neuron activations, a novel sufficient conditions are established towards the existence, uniqueness and global robust stability of the equilibrium point, finally, a examples with their simulations are given to show the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Comparison between Nonnormal Process Capability Study Based on Two Kinds of Transformations
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Standard process capability index is based on the assumption that process output obeys normal distribution. There exist a lot of process outputs which don't obey normal distribution, such as F distribution, G distribution, ? 2 distribution, and ß distribution. There are many ways to transform non-normal data to normal data, two of which are using the Box-Cox transformation and Johnson transformation. In this paper, some nonnormal distributions are studied by using these two transformations respectively, their process capability indexes are calculated, and the applicability and effectiveness of the two methods in process capability analysis are studied through a large number of repeated simulations. It is shown that Johnson transformation is more effective than Box-Cox transformation.

articleTitle: Variational Inequality on a Class of Variable Coefficient Elliptic Boundary Value Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Contact problem widely exists in diverse fields. Many contact problems are induced to boundary values and variational problem. Boundary variational inequality methods have been playing crucial roles in contact problem field, inducing all the boundary conditions and contact conditions to one variational inequality and making the theoretical analysis very easy. There are many articles using variational inequalities to study elliptic boundary value problems. And most of the problems are induced to a Laplace equation or Poisson equation and then to solve first or second boundary value problem which are the constant coefficient elliptic partial differential equations. Corresponding with a class of variable coefficient elliptic boundary value problems, a variational inequality is obtained using Green formula. At the same time the equivalence of the two problems (that is a variable coefficient elliptic boundary value problem and equal variational inequality) and the existence and uniqueness of solutions in this paper are proved.

Author Keywords: variable coefficient elliptic boundary value problems

articleTitle: The Existence of the Solution of the Extended General Mixed Variational Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: By using the auxiliary principal technology, this work proposed the fixed function for a new class of the variational inequalities, which is called the extended general mixed variational inequalities. This actical firstly proved the existence and the uniqueness of the solution of the fixed function, then studied the existence of the solution of the extended general mixed variational inequalities, at last it suggested the expression by involving the resolvent operator.

articleTitle: The Development Stage Positioning Research for an Innovative City
publicationTitle: 2010 First ACIS International Symposium on Cryptography, and Network Security, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, E-Commerce and Its Applications, and Embedded Systems
abstract: Building an innovative city is the localization and materialization of building an innovation-oriented country and is a complex systematic social project which should have scientific theoretical basis and guidance. With the life cycle theory and the research results of existing innovative cities, we position the development of the innovative city as four stages qualitatively, which is germination, growth, stability and differentiation. The index system for development stage positioning is constructed combining the experience of domestic innovative cities. Index data are determined by normalizing comparative standard values. Based on the improved method of principal component analysis, the development stage position model for innovative city is constructed.
